scope: The 18-page Stanford-hosted article and accompanying supplement only.
disclosure: The researchers drafting these questions had already read this source. This freeze precedes the structured extraction and any model comparison, not prior knowledge of the paper. This is a purposively chosen information-location audit, not a blinded experiment or formal preregistration.
rules: Preserve main-article evidence and supplement evidence separately.
Explicit means the requested information is stated at the requested object level; partial means some required information is missing.
For absence, report not found in these sources; do not infer that the lab lacks the records.
Never attach campaign or group ranges to a particular specimen without an explicit link.
Only explicit information counts as fully recoverable; partial, inferred, absent and ambiguous information remain separate.
Not found can be an appropriate answer, but is not recovery of the missing experimental information.
No model scoring until each scored reference answer is human-checked. Human review of selected rows does not verify other rows.
Amendments require a new version and a reason; preserve this file.

questions.question: Which deposition technique was used for the AlN films?
questions.required: Technique including sputtering excitation and reactive operation.

questions.question: What manufacturer and model identify the AlN deposition instrument?
questions.required: Manufacturer and model; a generic technique alone is insufficient.

questions.question: What substrate stack was used for the standard cross-plane AlN specimens?
questions.required: Underlying substrate, intervening material and its thickness; do not substitute the in-plane membrane stack.

questions.question: Was the substrate actively heated or cooled during AlN deposition?
questions.required: Explicit thermal-control mode; a temperature bound alone is insufficient.

questions.question: What typical stabilized substrate-temperature range is described during deposition?
questions.required: A typical stabilized range with its qualifier, not merely an upper bound or a heater setpoint; do not imply a per-run temperature trace.

questions.question: What nitrogen fraction of the argon-plus-nitrogen gas mixture was explored?
questions.required: Definition of fraction and numerical explored range, not only the favorable subset.

questions.question: What chamber-pressure range was explored for deposition?
questions.required: Full explored numerical range and unit, not only favorable conditions.

questions.question: What DC sputtering-power range was explored?
questions.required: Full explored numerical range and unit, not only favorable conditions.

questions.question: What target-to-substrate distance range was explored?
questions.required: Full explored numerical range and unit, not only favorable conditions.

questions.question: Which measurement methods were used to determine AlN film thickness?
questions.required: Explicit identification of the thickness measurement methods; a thickness value alone is insufficient.

questions.question: What metal and thickness describe the TDTR transducer?
questions.required: Both transducer material and nominal thickness; do not substitute the in-plane heater.

questions.question: What maximum cross-plane thermal conductivity and accompanying uncertainty are explicitly reported?
questions.required: Value, stated uncertainty and units; preserve the uncertainty notation without inventing a confidence level.

questions.question: How many spatial locations were measured by TDTR per sample, and how were their variations handled?
questions.required: Number of locations and stated treatment of variation; these are not independent depositions.

questions.question: How many independent deposition repeats at the recipe associated with the maximum cross-plane conductivity are identified?
questions.required: Count explicitly linked to that recipe; campaign size, multiple spots or thickness variation across nominal repeats do not supply this count.

questions.question: What exact nitrogen fraction, pressure, power and target distance are linked to the specimen producing the maximum cross-plane conductivity?
questions.required: All four exact settings and an explicit link to the identified result. A favorable multi-parameter window is insufficient.

questions.question: Can a complete deposition-by-deposition recipe-to-specimen-to-thermal-result table be recovered for the reported campaign?
questions.required: Inspect all tables, figures, captions and text for explicit run identifiers and linked records. A deposition count or aggregate trend is insufficient; state that any absence conclusion is bounded to this source packet.
